Package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog

Class BolusDeliverySummaryHistoryLog

java.lang.Object
com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog.HistoryLog
com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog.BolusDeliverySummaryHistoryLog
public class BolusDeliverySummaryHistoryLog extends HistoryLog
Written as each bolus completes, just before BolusIobEntryHistoryLog (opcode 195), on t:slim X2 and Mobi. Tandem publishes no name for opcode 194, so this class name is provisional, and every payload field is exposed raw: the relations below are exact, but what the pump uses them for is not known. Bytes 12-13 were zero in every record observed. See https://github.com/jwoglom/pumpX2/issues/144.

    • getUnknownU8At10

      public int getUnknownU8At10()
      Returns:
      byte 10: the number of boluses, this one included, whose 194 records fall within roughly the last 60 minutes (the records they were summed from for getUnknownFloatAt22()). The exact window edge could not be reproduced; records 60-61 minutes apart are sometimes in, sometimes out.

    • getUnknownU8At11

      public int getUnknownU8At11()
      Returns:
      byte 11: increments by one per bolus and wraps from 29 to 0
